upstream_cases.scope: Every case in the eleven retained files; no filtering; selected coverage only.

walkthrough.scope: Literal shell-block replay with piped command input; expected schema, accepted instance and OpenAPI output asserted.

observations: No edit submitted; complete checkpoint bytes unchanged

fault_evidence.scope: Markers identify point, action and process; failed publication, uncertainty, killed process and idempotent replay observed locally.

limits: local-2020-12-v1 admission subset; external, recursive and dynamic references rejected
Format is annotation-only; guidance is advisory
Schema: 64 KiB, 256 schema locations, 4096 expansion visits, expansion depth 64
Constraint numbers: 1024-byte tokens, exponent magnitude at most 4096; preserved draft values remain editable
At most 100 findings with explicit truncation
OpenAPI description construction only; full OpenAPI conformance and invocation unclaimed
Fresh-actor continuation, reuse economics, remote deployment and hardware power-loss guarantees unclaimed
corrections: Oracle JSON files and traces were transcribed from the pre-implementation task after initial implementation began; see the audit timing correction.
Initial compile and test harness failures are retained in their logs. Final application runs pass.
Boolean-schema findings use the validator's keyword identity. Profile assembly reads the bootstrap declaration once.
Guidance marks reference sibling intersections incomplete; the final application tests include the intersecting enum case.

compatibility.scope: Copies of saved checkpoints from earlier milestones reopened without mutation; composition tree compared to its existing expected output.
